Recomendada uma vez por semana. Executa,: Recommended once a week. Runs, in this order: CHKDSK /scan (checks and repairs the disk while Windows is running), DISM /RestoreHealth (repairs the Windows image using Windows Update) and SFC /scannow (replaces corrupted system files with the good copy). DISM runs before SFC so SFC uses the already repaired image. Takes 10 to 30 minutes; it can be cancelled. If anything is left that can only be repaired with the disk free, the repair is scheduled for the next startup. This is not the same as the Automatic weekly cleanup.
